import numpy as np
import polars as pl

from plotnine import *

DATA = "data/case/"          # keep this relative path: it must work on every laptop

stores = pl.read_csv(DATA + "stores_2025.csv")
ab = pl.read_csv(DATA + "ab_test.csv", try_parse_dates=True)
weekly = pl.read_csv(DATA + "weekly_sales.csv", try_parse_dates=True)
plan = pl.read_csv(DATA + "plan_q1_2026.csv", try_parse_dates=True)
customers = pl.read_csv(DATA + "customers.csv", try_parse_dates=True)
transactions = pl.read_csv(DATA + "transactions.csv", try_parse_dates=True)


def adstock(x, decay, max_lag=10):
    """Geometric adstock: this week's spend plus a decaying share of past weeks' spend."""
    w = decay ** np.arange(max_lag + 1)
    w = w / w.sum()
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    out = np.zeros_like(x)
    for lag, wl in enumerate(w):
        out[lag:] += wl * x[: len(x) - lag]
    return out
